title: Implement report model 0.2, schema pin, status-derived CLI exit codes and minimal golden
summary: Commit c1c83fd adds report model 0.2 in scanner/src/dogwatch/report.py: Finding, Locator, Status, derive_status, exit_code_for_status, and build_report with DC-R8 canonical sorting and explicit DC-R6 converters. The same commit replaces report-0.1.schema.json with report-0.2.schema.json, moves the report, schema, CLI-pin and golden tests to 0.2, and regenerates fixtures/minimal/expected-report.json through make regen-fixtures only. Commit 850def4 adds the module-level cli.scan seam and the IC-CLI-1 processing order: the scan-time stderr render runs after a successful write, and the exit code comes from exit_code_for_status(report status). It also adds the four-mode, stderr-mirror, write-failure, guard and seam tests to test_cli.py, and appends FR-018 render tests to test_diagnostics.py. make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures exit 0 at each commit, so there is no red window.
